blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep learning in medical imaging is constrained by data scarcity and by privacy regulations that make centralizing patient data across institutions impractical. Federated Learning (FL) addresses these constraints by keeping data local, but its distributed nature exposes training to strong statistical heterogeneity. Multicentric medical data is particularly affected, exhibiting a mixed skew that combines feature, label, concept, and quantity shifts across centers. Personalized FL mitigates heterogeneity by tailoring a model to each client, yet most methods assume training from scratch, which is unrealistic given the high dimensionality of medical features relative to the limited data available. We propose the Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained (PAFP) framework, a personalized FL approach built on a pre-trained backbone. PAFP inserts client-specific Feature Alignment modules before the fine-tuned blocks to realign hidden feature distributions toward a server-aggregated target. On the FedISIC benchmark, PAFP attains the highest unweighted balanced accuracy while reducing inter-client performance variance roughly six-fold relative to the strongest baseline, yielding accuracy and cross-client equity jointly. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP.
blocks.zh: 医学成像方面的深入学习受到数据稀缺和隐私条例的限制,这些条例使将病人数据集中到各机构的做法不切实际。 联邦学习(FL)通过保持数据本地化来解决这些制约因素,但其分布性质使培训暴露于统计高度异质性。 多中心医学数据尤其受到影响,显示出一种混合的SKW,将特征、标签、概念和数量跨中心变化结合起来。 个性化的FL通过为每个客户量身定做一个模型来缓解异质性,然而大多数方法都假设从零开始训练,这不现实,因为相对于有限的数据,医疗特征的维度很高. 我们提出了个性化的Aligner Federation Pretrained(PAFP)框架,这是一种建立在一个预先培训的骨干基础上的个性化的FL方法. PAFP 在微调的块之前插入客户端特异性对齐模块,以调整隐藏的特性分布到服务器汇总的目标. 在FedISIC基准上,PAFP取得了最高的未加权平衡准确度,同时相对最强基线减少了大约6倍的客户间业绩差异,从而产生了准确度和共同的跨客户权益。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP上公开查阅。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Machine learning and deep learning models are attracting increasing interest in the medical imaging field to address various tasks such as tumor segmentation, disease prediction, anomaly detection, and modality to modality translation [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
However, one of the biggest problems that the community is facing when it comes to training a medical imaging deep learning model is the lack of data. This data scarcity is due to several factors [ 2 , 3 ] , such as the need for specialized expertise to annotate training data, the necessity of patient consent, and strict privacy regulations and legal barriers (GDPR in Europe, HIPAA in the USA, etc.) that protect patient data but make the process of sharing across institutions complicated, if not impossible.
blocks.zh:
机器学习和深层学习模型正在吸引对医学成像领域越来越多的兴趣,以解决各种任务,如肿瘤分化、疾病预测、异常检测和模式翻译[1、2、3]。
然而,社区在培训医学成像深层学习模型时面临的最大问题之一是缺乏数据。 这种数据稀缺是由于若干因素[2,3],例如需要专业知识来注释培训数据,需要病人同意,严格的隐私条例和法律障碍(欧洲的GDPR,美国HIPAA等),这些都保护了病人数据,但使各机构之间的共享进程变得复杂,甚至不可能。

blocks.en:
Federated Learning (FL) is a machine learning paradigm that addresses these privacy regulations and legal barriers [ 4 , 5 ] .
Instead of aggregating data from multiple clients (e.g., medical centers), as a traditional centralized learning approach would, FL keeps the data localized at every client and transmits the models to a server, whose goal is to gather and aggregate each client’s model.
In particular, FL in medical settings is typically framed as a cross-silo scenario [ 6 ] . This implies a small number of clients, each holding a large dataset and sufficient computational power, and acting as a trustworthy party. This stands in contrast to cross-device FL, which assumes the opposite.
However, the distributed nature of FL introduces new challenges, particularly the issue of data heterogeneity [ 5 , 7 , 8 ] , where the data distribution is highly variable across clients (i.e., non-IID data). This problem creates diverging optimization directions during local training, which leads to a consensus issue commonly known as client drift. Medical imaging is particularly exposed to such phenomena, with feature skew, label skew, concept skew, and quantity skew naturally occurring across institutional datasets.
The objective of traditional FL is to learn a single global model that generalizes well across all client datasets. Such an objective can be very hard to achieve under severe heterogeneity. To overcome this limitation, Personalized Federated Learning (pFL) shifts the paradigm [ 9 ] . In contrast to traditional FL, pFL does not attempt to learn a one-size-fits-all global model; instead, it aims to adapt and tailor models to the specific data distribution of each individual client. In this context, the global model essentially serves as a shared baseline to facilitate knowledge transfer toward the local clients.
However, most of the approaches proposed in the literature assume training from scratch. These methods are not realistically suitable for medical imaging applications, given that the feature space is highly dimensional while the amount of available training data is severely limited. Thus, it is necessary to leverage pre-trained models [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] in this context.
In this work, we focus on the medical image classification task and validate our approach on the FedISIC2019 dataset from the FLamby benchmark [ 14 ] , a real-world, naturally partitioned federated skin-lesion classification problem that exhibits strong inter-client heterogeneity.
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We formalize the pFL problem in the context of medical imaging, a formulation whose scope extends beyond this domain • We analyze the data shift across clients. • We propose the Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained (PAFP) framework, a pFL approach based on a pre-trained model, using injected alignment modules before the fine-tuned block, which is client specific.

联邦学习(FL)是一种机器学习范式,可以解决这些隐私条例和法律障碍[4,5].
FL不从多个客户端(如医疗中心)汇总数据,而是一种传统的集中式学习方法,而是将数据本地化保存在每个客户端,并将模型传送给服务器,服务器的目标是收集和汇总每个客户端的模型.
特别是,医疗环境下的FL一般被设定为跨筒仓情景[6]. 这意味着少数客户端,每个客户端拥有庞大的数据集和足够的计算能力,并作为值得信赖的一方行事. 这与交叉装置FL形成对比,后者假设相反.
然而,FL的分布性质带来了新的挑战,特别是数据异质性问题[5,7,8],其中数据在客户之间的分布变化很大(即非IID数据). 这个问题在当地培训期间产生了不同的优化方向,这导致了一个通常被称为客户漂移的共识问题. 医学成像尤其暴露在这种现象中,特征skew,标签skew,概念skew,数量skew自然在机构数据集之间发生.
传统FL的目标是学习一个能够很好地概括所有客户数据集的单一全球模型. 在严重不均匀的情况下,这一目标可能很难实现。 为了克服这一限制,个性化联邦学习(pFL)改变了范式[9]. 与传统的FL不同,pFL并不试图学习一个一刀切的全球模式;相反,它旨在适应和调整每个客户的具体数据分布模式. 在这方面,全球模式基本上是促进向当地客户转让知识的共同基线。
然而,文献中提出的大多数方法都假定从零开始培训。 这些方法实际上不适合医学成像应用,因为特征空间高度维度,而现有的培训数据数量则受到严重限制。 因此,在这方面必须利用预先培训过的模型[10、11、12、13]。
在这项工作中,我们侧重于医疗图像分类任务,并验证我们对FLamby基准[14]的FedISIC2019数据集的方法,这是一个现实世界,自然分化的联邦皮液分类问题,显示出客户之间强烈的异质性.

blocks.en: II Related Works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工程

blocks.en: Traditional FL algorithms, such as FedAvg [ 4 ] , optimize a single global model under the implicit assumption of independent and identically distributed (IID) data across clients. Under realistic non-IID settings, statistical heterogeneity causes the global model to converge toward a sub-optimal compromise that may perform poorly on individual client distributions [ 7 ] . To mitigate this client drift, methods like FedProx [ 15 ] , SCAFFOLD [ 16 ] , and MOON [ 17 ] introduce proximal terms, control variates, or contrastive losses, respectively. However, these optimization-based strategies still fundamentally aim to produce a single shared model, limiting their efficacy on highly skewed local data.
blocks.zh: 传统的FL算法,如FedAvg [4],在跨客户端独立和相同分布(IID)数据的隐含假设下,优化了单一的全球模型. 在现实的非IID环境下,统计异质性导致全球模式趋同,形成一种不理想的折衷方案,在单个客户分布方面可能表现不佳[7]. 为了减轻这种客户端漂移,FedProx [15],SCAFFOLD [16],和MOON [17] 等方法分别引入了近似术语,控制变量,或对比性损失. 然而,这些基于优化的战略的根本目的仍然是产生一个单一的共享模式,限制其效力于高度扭曲的地方数据。

blocks.en: Personalized Federated Learning (pFL) shifts the objective to a family of models tailored to local distributions. Local adaptation refines a global model either through simple fine-tuning or meta-learning initializations (e.g., Per-FedAvg [ 18 ] ) for rapid convergence. Regularization-based methods like Ditto [ 19 ] jointly optimize global and local models to balance consensus and personalization. Architecture-based methods introduce structural decoupling: FedBN [ 20 ] , FedPer [ 21 ] , and FedRep [ 22 ] retain specific local layers while sharing the feature extractor. Feature-decoupling methods (DBE [ 23 ] , FDSE [ 24 ] ) extract client-invariant global features alongside localized representations. Finally, to specifically handle label skew, methods like FedLC [ 25 ] calibrate logits based on class probabilities to prevent overfitting to minority classes.
blocks.zh: 个性化的联邦学习(pFL)将目标转移到一个适合当地分布的模式家庭. 地方适应通过简单的微调或元学习初始化(如Per-FedAvg [18])来完善全球模式,以快速趋同. Ditto[19]等基于规范化的方法联合优化全球和地方模式,以平衡共识和个人化. 基于架构的方法引入了结构脱钩: FedBN [20], FedPer [21], FedRep [22] 在共享特征提取器的同时保留特定的局部层. 特性-脱钩方法(DBE [23],FDSE [24])在本地化表达的同时提取客户端-互不相同的全球特征. 最后,为了专门处理标签skew,类似FedLC[25]根据阶级概率校准日志的方法可以防止过量适应少数阶级.

blocks.en: Mixed Skew and Decoupled Personalization . In practical medical scenarios, clients simultaneously face domain shift (sensor variability / feature skew) and class imbalance (pathology prevalence / label skew). This mixed skew defeats traditional pFL methods designed for a single skew type, prompting the recent shift toward decoupling visual and statistical variability treatments. For instance, FED-ROD [ 26 ] introduces a two-predictor framework on top of a shared, actively trained feature extractor. It optimizes a generic head using a class-balanced loss while learning a personalized add-on head via empirical risk minimization. Similarly, Fed-CO 2 [ 27 ] relies on mutual knowledge distillation between a global online model (using personalized BN layers) and a client-specific offline model. However, because these architectures require training the entire backbone from scratch or maintaining compute-intensive dual networks, they remain heavy and prone to overfitting or destabilization under severe data scarcity.
blocks.zh: 混合滑冰和脱钩个人化。 在实际医疗情景中,客户同时面临域位变化(sensor unction / 特征 skew)和类不平衡(病理流行/标签 skew). 这种混合skew挫败了为单一skew类型设计的传统的pFL方法,促使最近转向了将视觉和统计变异处理脱钩. 例如,FED-ROD [26] 在一个共同的、经过积极培训的特征提取器之上引入了双前导框架。 它利用班级平衡损失来优化通用头,同时通过经验风险最小化来学习个性化加成头. 同样,Fed-CO 2[27]依靠全球在线模型(使用个性化的BN层)和客户专用离线模型之间的相互知识分解. 然而,由于这些架构需要从零开始培训整个骨干或维持计算密集的双重网络,因此它们仍然很重,在数据严重短缺的情况下容易过度调整或不稳定。

blocks.en:
Federated Transfer Learning (FTL) & Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (FedPEFT). To address data scarcity in domains like medical imaging, FTL [ 12 ] leverages pre-trained models to initialize the federated network.
However, naive fine-tuning across clients under severe non-IID conditions often causes catastrophic forgetting of the pre-trained prior or fails to properly personalize features [ 13 ] . To achieve stable personalization without the overhead of full-network training, recent paradigms shift toward FedPEFT .
Pioneered in NLP [ 28 , 29 ] , FedPEFT inserts lightweight adapters into a strictly frozen backbone. For example, AdaFL [ 30 ] freezes over 99% of parameters to align biased representations with negligible overhead.
This paradigm has transitioned to Computer Vision [ 31 , 32 ] and medical imaging (e.g., FedFMS [ 33 ] , which federates the Segment Anything Model). Beyond simple insertion, recent works like PERADA [ 34 ] regularize personalized adapters with a distilled global adapter, effectively balancing local personalization with global generalization capabilities.
To address memory constraints on heterogeneous edge devices, frameworks like Fed-HeLLo [ 35 ] propose Heterogeneous LoRA Allocation (HLA) to dynamically distribute trainable layers. Finally, for black-box foundation models, ZOOPFL [ 36 ] employs Zeroth-Order Optimization (ZOO) and input surgery to bypass internal backpropagation, while post-hoc methods like CCVR [ 37 ] debias the global classifier via virtual Gaussian representations to mitigate label skew.
blocks.zh:
联邦转移学习(FTL) & 参数-效果优美(FedPEFT). 为解决医疗成像等领域的数据稀缺问题,FTL[12]利用预先训练过的模型来初始化联邦网络.
然而,在严重的非IID条件下,对客户进行天真微调往往会造成灾难性的忘记事先受过训练的特征或未能适当个性化[13]. 为了实现稳定的个性化而无需全网络培训,最近的范例转向了FedPEFT。
在NLP[28,29]中先锋,FedPEFT将轻量级适配器插入严格冻结的骨干. 例如,AdaFL[30]冻结了99%以上的参数,使偏颇的表述与可忽略不计的间接费用保持一致。
这种范式已经向计算机视野[31,32]和医学成像(如FedFMS[33],它结合了任何部分模型)转变. 除了简单的插入外,PERADA[34]等近期作品将个性化适配器与蒸馏的全球适配器规范化,有效平衡了本地个性化与全球通用能力.
为了解决各种边缘设备的内存限制,Fed-HELLo[35]等框架提出异质LORA分配(HLA),以动态分配可训练层. 最后,对于黑盒基础模型,ZOOPFL [36] 使用Zeroth-Order优化(ZOO)和输入手术来绕过内部反传播,而像CCVR [37] 这样的Hoc后方法则通过虚拟高斯表示器去除全球分类器,以减轻标签skew.

blocks.en: Robustness in Federated PEFT. While standard FedPEFT methods focus on efficiency, they remain highly susceptible to noisy data and aggregation inconsistencies. Specifically, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) components can inadvertently amplify bias in the presence of label noise [ 32 ] . To combat this, RFedLR [ 38 ] proposes Sensitivity-aware Robust Tuning (SRT), which selectively updates noise-sensitive parameters based on gradient discrepancies between clean and noisy proxies. Furthermore, to address the sub-optimality of naive LoRA averaging, RFedLR introduces Adaptive Federated LoRA Aggregation (AFLA), which dynamically weights client updates based on parameter importance (measured via Fisher Information and noise sensitivity), rather than relying on simple parameter averaging.
blocks.zh: 强势在联邦PEFT。 虽然FedPEFT标准方法注重效率,但它们仍然极易受到吵闹的数据和汇总不一致的情况。 具体来说,Low-Rank适应(LORA)组件可以无意中放大标签噪声存在的偏差[32]. 为了与这种情况作斗争,RFedLR[38]提出了敏锐感知强力图宁(SRT),根据干净和吵闹的代词之间的梯度差异,有选择地更新对噪声敏感的参数. 此外,为了解决天真LORA平均率的次优问题,RFedLR引入了适应性Fonion LORA聚合(AFLA),它根据参数重要性(通过Fisher信息和噪音敏感度衡量)对客户端更新进行动态加权,而不是依赖简单的参数平均率.

blocks.en:
Positioning our approach. While existing FedPEFT methods successfully reduce parameter overhead, they largely focus on generic personalization or global-local regularization (e.g., PERADA leverages knowledge distillation to reconcile global-local objectives). Frameworks such as RFedLR have highlighted the vulnerability of standard adapter-based methods to label noise.
However, these robust frameworks are primarily reactive, focusing on filtering or mitigating the impact of noisy inputs, rather than addressing the structural mixed skew inherent in medical imaging. In contrast, PAFP adopts a proactive stance against distribution shift
by positioning internal alignment modules to standardize features before the fine-tuned blocks.
blocks.zh:
定位我们的方法。 虽然现有的FEDPEFT方法成功地减少了参数间接费用,但它们主要侧重于通用个性化或全球-地方规范化(例如,PERADA利用知识提炼来调和全球-地方目标)。 RFedLR等框架突出了基于标准适配器的方法对噪声进行标签的脆弱性.
然而,这些强有力的框架主要是被动反应的,侧重于过滤或减轻噪音投入的影响,而不是解决医学成像中固有的结构混合摇摆。 相比之下,PAFP对分配转变采取了积极主动的立场。
通过定位内部对齐模块,在微调区块之前将特性标准化。

blocks.en:
Feature skew induces distributional divergence not only in the input space 𝒳 \mathcal{X} , but also across the intermediate representation spaces H ( l ) H^{(l)} inside the feature extractor. Specifically, for a pre-trained model where L L blocks are fine-tuned, the hidden representation at each fine-tuned layer l l , denoted H ( l ) H^{(l)} , exhibits a divergence in its feature distribution. Left unaddressed, this divergence propagates through the fine-tuning process, causing model divergence and ultimately leading to a collapse in consensus between
fine-tuned client layers.

blocks.en: To mitigate this, we introduce Feature Alignment (FA) modules, each inserted before a corresponding fine-tuned block. Each FA module consists of a Group Normalization layer, a position-wise affine transformation across channels implemented as a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution, and a SiLU activation, operating jointly as a learned transformation of the local feature distribution.
blocks.zh: 为了缓解这种情况,我们采用了特性对齐(FA)模块,每个模块都插入在相应的微调块之前。 每个FA模块包含一个Group Normalization层,作为1×1 1\times 1 convolution执行的跨通道位置亲和转换,以及SiLU激活,作为本地特性分配的学习转化共同运行.

blocks.en: The parameters of the FA modules are client-specific and belong to v k v_{k} . Their role is to realign each client’s local representations toward a shared target distribution obtained by aggregating statistics across clients, so that every fine-tuned block receives a representation H ( l ) H^{(l)} whose feature distribution is consistent across clients. This consistency limits the divergence of local updates and improves agreement on the shared weights w w .
blocks.zh: FA模块的参数是针对客户的,属于v k v_{k}. 他们的作用是调整每个客户的本地代表, 以通过汇总客户之间的统计数据来实现共同的目标分布, 这种一致性限制了本地更新的分歧,并改进了共享权重ww的协议.

blocks.en:
Our FA modules are inspired by FDSE [ 24 ] , which similarly introduces
learnable modules to address distributional shift across clients. Our approach
differs in two key aspects. First, we update the global target statistics using
an Exponential Moving Average across communication rounds, rather than a direct
average, in order to stabilize convergence and reduce sensitivity to round-to-round
fluctuations in client participation. Second, since the FA modules are injected
directly into a pre-trained backbone, we initialize the 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution
using a Dirac delta (identity) initialization [ 39 ] , setting its
kernel to an identity mapping with zero bias, while the Group Normalization
affine parameters are initialized to unit scale and zero shift. This ensures
that, at the start of fine-tuning, the FA modules do not perturb the pre-trained
representations, thereby avoiding the training instability that would otherwise
arise from inserting randomly initialized layers into an already-converged
backbone.

blocks.en: We introduce two variants of our method. Standard PAFP uses a single optimizer to update both the local parameters v k v_{k} and shared parameters w w based on the joint loss. blocks.en:
For each experiment, we report the mean and standard deviation of the balanced accuracy over 5 independent runs.
We evaluate all baselines from a pFL perspective, even those that were not originally designed as pFL methods.
Concretely, for every method we report the performance of each client’s local fine-tuned model at the end of its local training, rather than that of the aggregated global model as is conventional for traditional FL methods.
This ensures all methods are assessed on the same footing, namely their per-client personalized performance.
We report per-client balanced accuracy, as well as two aggregate measures:
the weighted average, using data proportion n k / N n_{k}/N , and the unweighted average, using equal client weighting 1 / K 1/K , to assess overall system performance from both a population-level and a client-level perspective, respectively.
In the context of pFL where the goal is to obtain the best local model for each client, an unweighted average metric provides a more faithful assessment of the system, as it prevents large clients from masking the poor performance of smaller ones.
To evaluate whether a given method reduces performance disparity across clients, we further report the inter-client variance of balanced accuracy, computed within each run and then averaged (with standard deviation) across the 5 runs.

blocks.en:
Experimental results are presented in Table II . The isolated case corresponds to a non-FL scenario where each client trains a model solely on its own local data. These isolated results are included solely as a baseline reference, with our analysis focused primarily on the federated training outcomes. We benchmark the FL baselines FedAvg, DBE, and Ditto in a fine-tuned version (ft), since we start from a pre-trained model, which departs from the train-from-scratch assumption these methods were designed for.
We deliberately exclude Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods from our evaluation. While they share similarities with our local adaptation objective, our primary focus is isolating and addressing data skew rather than optimizing parameter efficiency.

blocks.en: VII Discussion
blocks.zh: 七、结 论 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The strongest configuration couples the
FA modules with an alternating optimization schedule, and the gap between this
variant and the single-optimizer one is informative. Because PAFP fine-tunes a
backbone pre-trained on natural images, all clients start from a common,
already-structured latent space. Before inter-client heterogeneity becomes the
dominant obstacle, every client must first adapt the shared weights w w from the
natural-image domain to the medical-imaging domain. Only once w w has specialized
to medical imaging does the residual divergence between client distributions
become the problem the FA modules are meant to solve. We hypothesize that alternating between rounds that update the shared parameters and rounds that update the local parameters allows the system to interleave these two processes: global domain adaptation (natural to
medical) and local adaptation to each client’s distribution. In the
single-optimizer variant, by contrast, the alignment gradient flows into w w from
the first round, pushing the shared backbone to satisfy a client-specific
alignment objective before it has adapted to the medical domain. This conflates
the two adaptation problems and perturbs the shared representation, which we
believe explains its lower and less stable performance. That the alternating
variant simultaneously attains the best unweighted average and the lowest
inter-client variance supports this reading: shielding w w from the alignment
gradient yields both a better shared representation and more equitable
personalization.

blocks.en: Several limitations temper these conclusions. First, our evaluation covers a single dataset and imaging modality (FedISIC dermoscopy). While the problem formulation and the PAFP architecture make no domain-specific assumptions, the generality of the approach beyond dermoscopic classification remains argued rather than empirically demonstrated. Second, although we formalize four types of skew, only feature skew and label skew receive dedicated mechanisms. Concept drift and quantity skew are handled only implicitly: quantity skew in particular is reflected in our unweighted evaluation and in the data-proportional aggregation, but PAFP contains no component that explicitly targets it. Third, the FA modules introduce a modest communication overhead, since each client transmits per-layer feature statistics alongside its weights at every round. This corresponds to 56,672 statistics, equivalent to an increase of 453 kB of communication per client. Compared to the 3,181,612 shared parameters, this represents a mere 1.7% increase in communication volume and can thus be considered negligible. Finally, because the backbone model was pretrained on natural images rather than medical imaging, the observed performance gains may be confounded by the domain shift. Consequently, further experiments are required to isolate whether the proposed method effectively mitigates client heterogeneity independent of this initial domain gap.
blocks.zh: 这些结论有若干限制。 首先,我们的评价包括一个单一的数据集和成像模式(FedISIC dermoscopy)。 虽然问题表述和PAFP架构没有提出具体领域假设,但除皮肤分类外,方法的笼统性仍然有争论,而不是经验证明。 第二,尽管我们正式确定四种类型的skew,但只有特征skew和标签skew得到专用机制. 概念漂移和数量扭曲只被隐含地处理:数量扭曲尤其反映在我们未加权的评价和数据比例汇总中,但菲律宾菲律宾武装部队没有明确针对它的组成部分。 第三,FA模块引入了适度的通信间接费用,因为每个客户端在每一回合的权重的同时传输每个层次的特征统计. 这相当于56 672个统计数据,相当于每个客户的通信量增加了453 kB. 与3,181,612个共同参数相比,通信量只增加了1.7%。 最后,由于骨干模型在自然图像而不是医学成像上预先训练过,所观测到的性能增益可能因域位移而令人困惑. 因此,需要进行进一步实验,以隔离拟议方法是否有效缓解客户端的异质性,而独立于这个初始域间隙.

blocks.en:
Three directions follow naturally from this work. The most immediate is to extend PAFP to Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) , a non-quantitative modality whose signal intensities are not standardized across scanners, field strengths, and acquisition protocols, and which therefore exhibits particularly strong and structured inter-client feature skew. The second direction is to leverage a medical imaging foundation model to mitigate the domain gap that the backbone must bridge during early training, thereby isolating data skew as the primary bottleneck and more rigorously demonstrating PAFP’s efficacy.
The third direction is to address quantity skew explicitly within the mixed-skew setting, rather than leaving it to the aggregation and evaluation scheme, so that data-scarce clients are supported by a dedicated mechanism as feature and label skew already are. Together, these extensions would move the framework from a single-modality proof of concept toward the general treatment of mixed skew that motivates it.

这项工作自然遵循三个方向。 最直接的是将PAFP扩展至磁共振成像(MRI),这是一种非量化模式,其信号强度没有在扫描仪、实地优势和购置协议中标准化,因此显示出特别强大和结构化的客户间特性Skew。 第二个方向是利用医疗成像基础模型来缩小骨干在早期培训时必须弥补的域间隙,从而将数据Skew隔离为主要瓶颈,并更严格地证明PAFP的功效。
第三个方向是明确在混合缝隙内处理数量skew问题,而不是把它留给汇总和评价计划处理,这样数据稀缺客户就如同特性和标签skew已经一样得到专用机制的支持。 这些扩展加在一起,将使框架从单一模式的概念证明转向一般地处理促成其发展的混合摇摆。
